name: cicada
description: Connects Claude Code to the Cicada on this machine: the memory tools (MCP), the cicada skill, the hooks that save each session (Stop, with PreCompact and SessionEnd as a flush) and the hooks that add what Cicada remembers (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit). Needs Cicada installed: the app, or a source checkout set up with install.sh.

cicada_repo.title: Cicada source checkout (developer build only)
cicada_repo.description: Leave empty when the Cicada app is installed: the plugin runs the app's launchers in ~/.cicada/bin. For a source checkout set up with install.sh, name its folder (the one holding install.sh); its api/.venv runs the hooks and the memory tools.

memory_path.title: Memory folder (only if not the default)
memory_path.description: Leave empty for the default (~/cicada/memory, or what the app chose). Set it only when install.sh was run with another CICADA_MEMORY_PATH.

recall.title: Remember automatically
recall.description: Add a short note of what Cicada remembers at the start of a session and beside a message that mentions something it knows (read-only). Off: the agent sees your memory only when it asks for it.
